truth_boundary: Simulation scenarios are model evidence only. Hypothetical parameters remain assumptions until replaced by source-backed or measured values.

scenarios.label: 45° ideal lower bound
scenarios.purpose: Demonstrate that the published 26.01 N·m figure is only the ideal gravity-balancing lower bound at 30 kg and 45 degrees, not a climb-performance margin.

scenarios.label: 45° lossy hypothesis
scenarios.purpose: Show that the same ideal lower-bound torque becomes insufficient as soon as hypothetical drivetrain and rolling losses are introduced.

scenarios.label: 45° traction-limited hypothesis
scenarios.purpose: Show that increasing available wheel torque does not guarantee a climb when the tyre/surface traction ceiling is lower than requested drive force.

scenarios.label: Heartbeat-loss stopping envelope
scenarios.purpose: Visualize the known 500 ms software command timeout separately from the still-hypothetical physical deceleration after motor enable is removed.

scenarios.label: 45° parameter sensitivity
scenarios.purpose: Expose how torque, efficiency and traction assumptions change the 45-degree force balance rather than presenting one polished number as universal truth.

unknowns_to_replace: stall current and controller current limiting
physical wheel deceleration and stopping distance
